sources.title: Alphabet Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results (8-K exhibit 99.1)
Alphabet Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

items.statement: Q2 2026 revenue $119.8bn (+24%, +23% cc): Search & other $63.3bn (+17%), YouTube ads $11.1bn (+13%), subscriptions/platforms/devices $12.9bn (+15%), Google Cloud $24.8bn (+82%) with Cloud operating income $8.8bn (from $2.8bn). Operating margin 34%.
Revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations) $519.5bn at 2026-06-30, of which $513.9bn Google Cloud; just over 50% expected to be recognized within 24 months.
Capital expenditures $44.9bn in Q2 2026 (from $22.4bn) and $132.4bn over the trailing twelve months; free cash flow -$5.9bn in Q2 and $53.3bn TTM against operating cash flow of $185.7bn TTM.

June 2026: Class A/C common stock issued for $30.5bn net ($20.5bn public offering, $10.0bn private placement) and 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock for $19.1bn net (19 million shares, converting into Class A/C by May 2029), plus a $40bn at-the-market program (unused at June 30, intended mainly for employee equity tax obligations) and $20.3bn of senior notes in Q2; buybacks stopped (none in 2026 H1 versus $28.3bn a year earlier). Long-term debt $98.2bn.

Other income of $98.0bn in Q2 2026, mainly net unrealized gains on equity securities; net income $112.2bn and EPS $9.11 are therefore not operating earnings. Non-marketable securities $131.5bn (from $68.7bn at 2025 year end).
Acquisition of Wiz completed on 2026-03-11 for $29.5bn (after purchase price adjustments, excluding post-combination compensation); 2026 H1 acquisition payments $33.7bn.
Management statement: Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users, Gemini models process 22 billion API tokens per minute, and nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise.
